bylieve_finding.citation: Rugo HS et al. Lancet Oncol. 2024 Dec;25(12):e629-e638.
bylieve_finding.title: Alpelisib + fulvestrant after CDK4/6i in PIK3CA-mutated HR+/HER2- breast cancer (BYLieve CDK4/6i cohort)
bylieve_finding.relevance: DIRECTLY relevant — this is the alpelisib post-CDK4/6i trial. No histology stratification (ILC vs IDC) reported in abstract or found in PubMed-indexed analyses.
bylieve_finding.expression_of_concern: PMID 38142701 (Lancet Oncol Editors, Feb 2024) issued Expression of Concern about data integrity. This may affect trial credibility.
bylieve_finding.gap: No published ILC vs IDC outcome breakdown in BYLieve CDK4/6i cohort

gap_summary: No published ILC vs IDC outcome data for alpelisib in CDK4/6i-progressed patients from any trial (SOLAR-1, BYLieve, BYLIEVE, EPIK-B3, French early access). The gap is confirmed clean.
expression_of_concern_note: PMID 38142701 expression of concern may indicate data reliability issues with BYLieve CDK4/6i cohort. This does NOT invalidate the hypothesis — it further underscores why an ILC-specific prospective analysis is needed.
impact_on_hypothesis: GAP CONFIRMED clean. No evidence weakening or strengthening beyond what ILC-EXP-001 already established. BYLieve expression of concern is a regulatory/data integrity issue, not a scientific challenge to the hypothesis mechanism.
